title: Estimation of BLP models with high-dimensional controls
abstract: arXiv:2605.01594v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a framework for estimating demand in differentiated product markets with high-dimensional product characteristics, building on the Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995) model with market-level data; the number of characteristics may exceed the number of markets. First, we propose a Neyman orthogonal estimator in which high-dimensional nuisance parameters are estimated by machine-learning methods such as LASSO, and show that it is $\sqrt{T}$-asymptotically normal for the parameters of interest, such as the price coefficient and price heterogeneity, even when the nuisance parameters converge at slower rates. Second, under approximate sparsity, we provide LASSO-based nuisance estimators that attain the required rates, although mean utility is recovered from market shares only when the nonlinear parameters are known. Monte Carlo simulations show good finite-sample performance. We illustrate the method with Dominick's Fin

translated_title: 具有高维控制变量的BLP模型估计
translated_abstract: 本文在Berry、Levinsohn和Pakes（1995）使用市场层面数据的模型基础上，针对产品特征维度很高的差异化产品市场，建立了一个需求估计框架，其中产品特征的数量甚至可以超过市场的数量。首先，我们提出了一个Neyman正交估计量，其中高维冗余参数通过LASSO等机器学习方法进行估计，并证明即使冗余参数以较慢的速度收敛，该估计量对价格系数和价格异质性等关注参数仍具有√T渐近正态性。其次，在近似稀疏性条件下，我们提供了达到所需收敛速度的基于LASSO的冗余参数估计量，但只有在非线性参数已知的情况下才能从市场份额中恢复平均效用。蒙特卡洛模拟显示了良好的有限样本表现。我们以Dominick's Finer Foods的数据为例说明了该方法的应用。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合机器学习方法（LASSO）的Neyman正交估计框架，使BLP需求模型在产品特征数量可能超过市场数量的高维环境下，仍能对价格系数等关注参数获得√T渐近正态的估计。
